Cross-reference chunk files (devicesInit, home, screensInit, BasicFunctions, LightingEffect, MacroConfiguration, AdvancedKey, ConfigurationManagement) for call sites. Safety: until a command is proven read-only, do not send it from Rust; probe via a scratch script only.

title: F4: Port Compx mouse protocol + CLI
description: Port crates/proto-mouse from ../oh-my-gravastar-upstream/orbit-gravastar/src/protocol/mouse.rs (476 lines, MIT, has unit tests to port). Spec: docs in upstream docs/protocol-mouse.md. Transport: VID 0x3554, dongle PIDs F54B F575 F548 F577, wired F576 F549, usage page 0xFF02, report id 8, 16-byte payload [cmd,status,addrHi,addrLo,len,data*10,cksum]; checksum = (0x08 + sum bytes 0..14) & 0xFF == 0x55 i.e. byte15 = (0x4D - sum) & 0xFF. One request in flight; mouse may push unsolicited 0x0A reports. Commands: 01 identify (CID 18=GravaStar; MID 1-2 PAW3395 26k DPI, MID 3-5 PAW3950 32k), 03 online, 04 battery (voltage->percent table of 21 entries), 07 write flash, 08 read flash, 0E profile, 12 mouse fw, 1D dongle fw. Flash map: polling@0, stage count@2, current@4, LOD@10, DPI@12+4i, DPI color@44+4i, buttons@96+4i, light@160, debounce@169, motion sync@171, sleep@173 (x10s units 1,3,6,12,18,30,60,90), angle snap@175, ripple@177, light-off-moving@179, sensor mode@185. Scalars stored as [v, 0x55-v]; records end with check byte summing to 0x55. WRITABLE allowlist of 15 ranges - refuse everything else. NEVER implement: 05/06 pairing, 09 factory reset, 31 RF, B0-B7 bootloader. CLI: omg mouse info|battery|fw|config|get|set <field> --yes; DPI encode (raw=dpi/50-1 or /100-1 high range), clamp per sensor; wireless wake handling per OmaGravastar research/wake_and_battery.py. mouse-protocol/src/drivers/gravastar/hid.ts has TS reference + products.ts ID table. Unit tests: packet checksum vectors, DPI roundtrip, voltage curve (port from upstream tests).
close_reason: proto-mouse + omg mouse CLI done, 18 tests pass, pushed 0fc7808

title: F6: SparkPlayJoy 6x21 analog travel reader
description: Depends F2+F1. Implement crates/proto-sparkplayjoy (new crate or module in proto-he) per docs/protocol-sparkplayjoy.md (research agent writes it; fallback: HallJoy/docs/research/GRAVASTAR_MERCURY_V75_FIRMWARE_STATIC_ANALYSIS_2026-08-22.md + aula_win60he_protocol.h/.cpp in ../oh-my-gravastar-upstream/HallJoy). Framed protocol on usage 0xFFA0:0001: request 5C <len> <cmd> <cksum> <payload>; response cmd = request|0x80; checksum low byte of (35+0x5C+len+cmd+last-payload-byte); long responses continue over multiple 64-byte reports (65-byte Win32 buffer, report id 0). Read-only commands: sync 01, scale order 0x25 (precision 5um, min 5um, max ~3500um read live), default map 0x2B (2 rows x 21 factory key ids), active map 0x23 (14 x 4-byte queries -> function records), live travel 0x12 selector 02 half 01/02 -> 63 u16 samples each half = 6x21 matrix. Identity gate: only exact board IDs 16052201 (1CA5:2201 V75), 16052202 (1CA5:2202 V75 Pro), 2E022201 (1CA2:2201 V75 Lite) auto-claim; unknown 6x21 candidates require structural proof only. Fn function = 0xF001 -> extended keycode 0x409; Menu = HID 0x0065; never truncate Fxxx. CLI: omg kb travel-matrix [--watch] --json emitting {row,col,travel_um,actuated}. Verify on HE keyboard; if none available mark hardware-pending in code docs.
acceptance_criteria: docs/protocol-sparkplayjoy.md exists [DONE by research]; crates/proto-sparkplayjoy decodes sync/scale/map/travel; omg kb travel-matrix --json works or documented hardware-pending
close_reason: proto-sparkplayjoy crate done (lib-only), 25 tests, pushed 6663d73; CLI wiring pending
